title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Characterize the Act of a Village Group Leader Illegally Occupying Public Property by Taking Advantage of His Position

articles.content_en:
Sichuan Higher People's Court:
Your court's Request for Instructions on How to Characterize the Embezzlement of Public Property by a Village Group Leader through Abuse of Position (Chuan Gao Fa [1998] No. 224) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
For the act of a village group leader who, by taking advantage of his position, illegally takes possession of the collective property of the village group for himself, if the amount is relatively large, shall, in accordance with Article 271, paragraph 1, of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, be convicted and punished for the crime of embezzlement.
This reply.
